sensors.name: light sensor LLIGHT (the light from above, dim inside a tunnel)

actions.name: curve right in dim light (left wheel 40 %, right wheel 20 %)
curve left on black (left wheel 10 %, right wheel 40 %)
curve right on no black (left wheel 40 %, right wheel 10 %)

control_flow: driveInTheDark: if LLIGHT is below 70 %, curve with left wheel 40 % and right wheel 20 %; else call stopAtWall.
stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, stop; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left 10/40; else curve right 40/10.

likely_intent.description: Follow the black line; in the dark tunnel, where there is no line, drive straight through without touching its walls; then follow the line again after the tunnel.

decision_points.condition: the light sensor LLIGHT reads below 70 %

branches.outcome: dim light: it curves right, left wheel 40 %, right wheel 20 %
bright light: it goes on to stopAtWall

decision_points.condition: an obstacle is ahead at the front sensor

branches.outcome: an obstacle is ahead: it stops
no obstacle ahead: it goes on to followLine
black: it curves left, left wheel 10 %, right wheel 40 %
no black: it curves right, left wheel 40 %, right wheel 10 %
